mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_SCHEDULED_REPORT ( SCHEDULED_NAME, SHOP_TYPE, SHOP_NM, SHOP_ID, CAUSE, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{SCHEDULED_NAME}, #{SHOP_TYPE}, #{SHOP_NM}, #{SHOP_ID}, #{CAUSE}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
mapper.select: SELECT CU.USER_ID, CA.USER_NO, CU.USER_PHONE, CU.USER_NM, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_NO = CU.USER_NO AND SEND_MAIL = 'N' AND USER_NEW_YN1 = 'N' AND USER_NEW_YN2 = 'N') AS SEND_MAIL_COUNT FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA INNER JOIN CBCI_USER CU WHERE CA.USER_NO = CU.USER_NO AND CU.USER_TYPE = '02' AND CU.USER_NO NOT IN ('37','38','40','41') GROUP BY CA.USER_NO HAVING SEND_MAIL_COUNT > 0

SELECT USER_NO, SHOP_TYPE, (SELECT CODE_NM FROM CBCI_CODE WHERE CODE_ID = SHOP_TYPE) AS SHOP_NM, SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_NO = ${USER_NO} AND SEND_MAIL = 'N' AND USER_NEW_YN1 = 'N' AND USER_NEW_YN2 = 'N' ORDER BY SHOP_TYPE

SELECT CA.USER_NO, CA.SHOP_ID, CA.SHOP_TYPE, CU.USER_ID, CU.USER_PHONE, CA.LOGIN_LOCK_NOTICE, CA.LOGIN_LOCK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_NO = CA.USER_NO AND LOGIN_LOCK = 'Y' AND LOGIN_LOCK_NOTICE < 3) AS COUNT_CNT, ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CBCI_CODE CC WHERE CODE_ID = CA.SHOP_TYPE) AS CODE_NM FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA INNER JOIN CBCI_USER CU WHERE CA.USER_NO = CU.USER_NO AND LOGIN_LOCK = 'Y' AND LOGIN_LOCK_NOTICE < 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA INNER JOIN CBCI_USER CU WHERE CA.USER_NO = CU.USER_NO AND LOGIN_LOCK = 'Y' AND LOGIN_LOCK_NOTICE >= 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_USE_MANAGEMENT( PAGE_VIEWS_COUNT, VISIT_COUNT, AVG_USE_TIME, STANDARD_DATE, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES( ${PAGE_VIEWS_COUNT}, ${VISIT_COUNT}, ${AVG_USE_TIME}, #{STANDARD_DATE}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
INSERT INTO CBCI_SCHEDULED_REPORT ( SCHEDULED_NAME, CAUSE, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{SCHEDULED_NAME}, #{CAUSE}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )

UPDATE CBCI_USER CU LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD ON CU.USER_CODE = CBPD.user_code SET CU.USER_TYPE = IF(CU.USER_TYPE = '01', '97', IF(CU.USER_TYPE = '02', '03', CU.USER_TYPE)), CBPD.status = RIGHT(CBPD.status, 2) WHERE CU.USER_TYPE != '00' AND LEFT(CBPD.status, 1) = 'U'
AND CBPD.expire_date <= now()

UPDATE CBCI_USER CU LEFT JOIN CBCI_BILLING_PAYMENT_DETAIL CBPD ON CU.USER_CODE = CBPD.user_code SET CU.USER_TYPE = IF(CU.USER_TYPE = '97', '01', IF(CU.USER_TYPE = '03', '02', CU.USER_TYPE)), CBPD.status = 'U-CC' WHERE CU.USER_TYPE != '00' AND CBPD.status = 'SB' AND DATE_FORMAT(CBPD.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')
